claims.claim: Toronto Police say Christopher Lawson, 43, of Toronto, was arrested in a suspected hate-motivated assault with a weapon at Danforth Avenue and Logan Avenue
The alleged assault occurred Tuesday, October 13, 2026, while the victim was working in the Danforth and Logan area
The suspect allegedly made anti-immigrant and anti-South Asian remarks at the victim before assaulting him
The victim called 9-1-1 and officers arrived while the suspect was still on scene, taking him into custody
Lawson is charged with Offence Motivated by Hatred related to an Assault with a Weapon, and Breach of Probation
Lawson was scheduled to appear at the Toronto Regional Bail Centre, 2201 Finch Avenue West, on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 10 a.m., room 102
The investigation is being treated as a suspected hate-motivated offence and is led by the Hate Crime Unit
Outcome of the October 14 court appearance is not published in these sources
The victim's condition, whether a weapon was recovered, and the prior probation matter are not stated in the police release
